posts.body:
Issue Summary:
Does Offsetting an animation in the Animation section not affect when not in the Battle Screen?
Details:
I added an Attack Animation to an Enemy Event when Not in Battle Mode and changing the Offset in Batch and Cell Properties doesnt affect where it occurs, the Attack Animation will occur Offset from my Character. Only changing the Animation to Head, Center, Feet will Offset the Attack Animation.
Plugin Used
: Alpha ABS, but the dev doesnt support this plugin anymore. I offset my character with this plugin because its attack area was offset but it created the issue with Animations being offset, so thats why I want to set Animations.
What tutorials or previous support threads have you referenced:
I watched the tutorial
RPG Maker MV Tutorial #29 - Animations
from SomeRandomDev.
